description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Migrate PhotoAlbum's Oracle-backed persistence to Azure Database for PostgreSQL, including photo binary data and Oracle-specific database behavior.
tasks.reason: The application currently uses Oracle Database with Oracle-specific JDBC driver, OracleDialect, and BLOB data types. Azure Database for PostgreSQL is the target managed relational database service on Azure, eliminating the need for self-managed Oracle infrastructure.
tasks.requirements: Migrate the Oracle JDBC data source, JPA dialect, SQL syntax, and schema definitions to Azure Database for PostgreSQL. Replace the Oracle JDBC driver with the PostgreSQL driver. Configure the Spring datasource and Hibernate dialect for PostgreSQL, convert Oracle-specific repository SQL to PostgreSQL-compatible equivalents, and migrate photo storage from Oracle BLOB to PostgreSQL bytea. Configure the datasource to connect to Azure Database for PostgreSQL using Managed Identity.
